notes: Minimum standards for registered workplace pension plans. The Canada Pension Plan (R.S.C. 1985, c. C-8) and Old Age Security (R.S.C. 1985, c. O-9) are federal. Teachers' plans sit under The Teachers' Pensions Act, C.C.S.M. c. T20, and pooled plans under The Pooled Registered Pension Plans (Manitoba) Act, C.C.S.M. c. P94.6.
